section_summary.extract_value: This section summarizes the findings of a single study, indicating that learning orientation positively predicts proactive and adaptive work role performance. It also highlights that self-leadership behavior-focused strategies fully mediate this relationship, and that self-leadership thought pattern and natural reward strategies moderate the mediation effect on proactive work role performance.
